topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The familiar walls of my apartment suddenly feel too thin, too exposed. The building, a home for so many years, is turning into condominiums. It’s just a change, they say, but it looms like an uncertain storm. What will happen to the quiet mornings and the cozy nights in? I can hardly focus, my mind scattered by the unknown. Every creak now sounds like a warning, every knock on the door an unwanted intruder. I find myself checking the mail more often, dreading yet hoping for news. The future hangs heavy, a weight I can’t quite shake.
